_comment: Bench-local samples banked BEFORE the #1236 quiescence guard existed, judged
contaminated by the machine rather than moved by the commit. Read by
renderer; the raw points stay in the gh-pages store untouched, because the
datum is evidence and only the JUDGEMENT about it belongs in git.
Heuristic (reproducible, and the bar is stated so the list can be argued with):
a sample is listed when more than 25% of its metrics are >10% slower than the
median of the five samples either side of it. A real code regression moves a
FAMILY of related rows by a plausible step; a busy neighbour moves a quarter of
the whole board at once, including rows the commit cannot reach, by margins
(+130%, +155%) no in-process delivery change has ever produced here.
Only samples that predate the guard need listing. Everything measured after it
flags itself at measure time through the A/A bracket, in its own `extra` field.

heuristic.suite: libtracer bench-local latency (ns, smaller is better, fixed pinned host)

samples.reason: 130/344 metrics >10% slow vs neighbours (37.8%), worst +155% — host load, not #1211
104/386 metrics >10% slow vs neighbours (26.9%), worst +133% — the sample #1236 was filed on
117/386 metrics >10% slow vs neighbours (30.3%), worst +150% — host load, not #1226
